::: {.videos}
3Blue1Brown builds a network with two hidden layers for handwritten digits,
and asks what features its layers might learn, in
[But what is a neural network?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aircAruvnKk) [@sanderson2017neuralnetwork].
:::

::: {.reading}
The introduction to *Deep Learning*, [Chapter 1](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/contents/intro.html),
explains representation learning and deep learning at more length [@goodfellow2016deep, Ch. 1].
:::
